description: Unit tests for the CordBuffer class in the Abseil library, testing buffer creation, capacity, move semantics, and consumption of buffer values.

classes.name: CordBufferTestPeer
classes.description: Helper class to access private methods of CordBuffer for testing.

classes.name: CordBufferTest
classes.description: Parameterized test suite for testing CordBuffer with various sizes.

methods.description: Tests the maximum payload size for different buffer sizes.

methods.description: Tests available data in buffer after setting length.

methods.name: CreateWithDefaultLimit
methods.description: Tests creating buffer with specified size limits.

methods.name: CreateWithCustomLimitWithinDefaultLimit
methods.description: Tests creating buffer with custom limit within default.

methods.name: CreateWithCustomLimit

methods.description: Tests consuming value from buffer and resetting length.
